export_holes.desc: frames a damage entity was exported (not hidden) with colliders == [], by type_key and Control / own FSM state

partial_presence.desc: sources enabled in 90-99.9 % of the instances entering a state (per phase): candidates for export gaps the empty-collider check does not see (or a source that left the view)

validation.support_note: NOT shown to cover unseen instances: held out anchor: 8 of 2417 contacts beyond 0.5 u - inflate it or keep it out of the planner until more data closes this

multi_hit_follow_ups.desc: hits of a connected multi-hit (multi_wounder) whose collider was exported within 90 frames before, not then: not checked against the support

partial_export_holes.desc: contacts whose source entity was exported with named damage colliders but not the one the damage event named (oracle ents[].colliders[].name): unexplained unless the entity was also exported without colliders then

ambient.desc: contacts with an ambient hazard (armed when the scan started), checked against the static _ambient/world support only

uncovered.desc: n counts (contact, template set) pairs; contacts the distinct contacts

templates.keys: <family>/<frame> (t from the attack start), <family>/<state>/<frame> (t from the state's entry; _tail = after the attack ended, t from its end); frame anchor | world (arena-fixed hazards) | world_all (every collider of the family in world coordinates: the support before the anchor or the side is known); ent/<type_key>/self: one hazard entity relative to where it armed (anchor = its position then, mirror 1, t from arming; entities.<tk>.self_template, arm_pos); _ambient/world: hazards armed when a scan started (static: one bin, in support at every t)
templates.support: support/<key>: the logged occupancy dilated by its validated residual (attacks.<A>.residual_u.radius[<key>], entities.<tk>.self_template.radius_u) and +-1 time bin; these are the support (DESIGN §3.5.3). The npz also keeps the logged family templates (<family>/<frame>, for the viewer). For the planner: hitbox_tables.planner_templates (+ hero hurtbox half-extents and margin) and SupportQuery

frames.anchor: x' = mirror * (x - anchor x), y' = y - anchor y (anchor = boss transform)

templates.arrays: <family>/instances (n, instance_columns), state_t (n, states: s from the start, nan = not entered), state_f (entry frames, -1), state_names, fights, windows (per instance, state and source: window_columns, template frame), window_states, window_sources, boss_path (t, n, x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, x_mean, y_mean; anchor frame), paths (instance, t, x', y'; families with a variable anchor, or all with --paths). Frame-by-frame colliders: the recordings (sources[].path, frames f_start..)
